name: Clean Files Entity
description: Cron/Drush tool that deletes unreferenced managed files under configured folders and files whose node file-usage points at a deleted node.
project_description:
🇺🇦

Please consider supporting Ukraine in a fight for their freedom and safety of Europe. 
 
 
 
 Module for automatically cleaning entity files that are no longer in use.

Files are cleaned by cron. To configure, you need to add lines to the file settings.php .

 

$config['clean_files_entity'] = [

 'folders' => [

 'public://node_images/',

 ],

 'max' => 100

];
